description: Download access for one digital order item. Created when the order is paid; checked on every download.
label: Download access

item_id.description: Order item this access is for. One grant per item

subscription_id.description: Set for subscription products. Access follows the subscription's status

status.description: suspended: the subscription is paused or canceled. revoked: the order was canceled or refunded, or an admin removed access

reason.description: Why access was suspended or revoked

download_counts.description: Downloads so far, keyed by deliverable id

download_limit.description: Downloads allowed per deliverable, copied from the product or app settings at purchase. Empty means unlimited

date_expires.description: Downloads stop after this date. Empty means never

date_update_notified.description: When the buyer was last emailed about a product update
